prompt: Create a finished illustrated key-art poster for an atmospheric pixel-art narrative adventure. Square 1024x1024. English text only, absolutely no Chinese characters. Exact large title CARRIAGE 07 in the upper 25 percent safe area, smaller subtitle A LIGHT LEFT ON beneath it. One single young traveler with dark brown hair, mustard yellow hooded jacket, teal trousers and brown satchel stands in the narrow central aisle of a vintage railway carriage, seen from a balanced elevated orthographic RPG perspective. The carriage is a long narrow strip, correctly scaled compact paired seats flank the aisle. Cold blue-green rainy landscape is visible outside on both sides. A single warm amber lamp and an open brass electrical cabinet promise rescue; the traveler holds a small ceramic fuse. Strong narrative focus, handcrafted detailed pixel-art textures, crisp silhouette, dark navy and moss green against warm amber, tasteful cinematic lighting. Design a cohesive illustration, not a screenshot, interface, sprite sheet, collage, diagram or layout study. No UI icons, no inventory, no buttons, no numbers except 07 in title. Keep main person and key lamp in central 60 percent; bottom 20 percent is quiet low-contrast rain and shadow for list overlays. Readable and intriguing at 160x160. No other text, no logos or watermark.
